evidence.OBSERVED.plain: A published figure attributable to a named official source document.
evidence.ESTIMATED.plain: Derived from observed data. The method is named and the number of transformation steps is shown.
evidence.SUPPORTING.plain: Real observed data, shown for context. It is not a demand or supply measure.
evidence.UNAVAILABLE.plain: This number does not exist and cannot currently be computed. The reason is given.
evidence.vsUnavailable: "Estimated" means the number exists but was derived. "Unavailable" means it does not exist and cannot currently be computed.
confidence.label: Confidence
confidence.MEDIUM.plain: Derived from observed data through one documented transformation.
confidence.LOW.plain: Derived through more than one transformation, or resting on a historical or proxy structure.
confidence.notNumeric: Confidence is a category, never a percentage or probability.

landing.heading: What this tells you, and what it does not
landing.whatItIs: This system shows where relative labour-demand signals are higher, at what confidence, over what coverage, and from which sources.
landing.whatItIsNot: It does not publish a demand-supply gap. It does not publish a shortage or a forecast, and it publishes no occupation-level supply figure. Those capabilities are reported as explicitly unavailable, each with a reason and the evidence that would unblock it.
landing.noTotal: No national total labour-demand figure is published. The measure is cumulative NCS vacancy registrations since inception, and most of it is not geographically attributable.
national.heading: National overview
national.observedNote: Vacancy counts as published. The NCS-sector to NIC-section alignment is the project's own.
national.estimatedNote: An estimated split of observed industry totals across NCO-2015 divisions, using an ILOSTAT/PLFS industry × occupation structure. Confidence varies by row.
state.heading: State view
state.trainingNote: Candidate counts within a named scheme and period. These are not a supply quantity: no occupation or trade dimension exists.
state.residualExcluded: The PAN-India residual is excluded from this comparison and disclosed separately. It is never allocated to a state or district.

occupation.heading: Occupation view
occupation.districts: Districts within a state, for this division
occupation.informative: Across districts within one state and one division, this ordering combines the enterprise and occupation structures, so it restates neither input. It remains an estimated allocation signal.
derivation.heading: How this signal is derived
derivation.note: The datasets below are factors in this signal, not independent evidence for it.
methodology.heading: Methodology & evidence
methodology.gap: Why no demand–supply gap is published
methodology.gapBody: A numeric gap can only be computed where demand and a supply quantity are measured at the same geography, occupation grain, unit, period and population definition. No occupation-level or trade-level geographic supply quantity exists, and the joint distribution cannot be recovered from the marginals that do. This is a property of the evidence, not a modelling difficulty.
methodology.hybrid: Why the pressure indicator is experimental only
methodology.hybridBody: A hybrid demand-pressure / training-system indicator was designed but is not implemented or published. Its classification changes depending on which training scheme is read, so it is not a production output.
methodology.vintagesBody: Figures on this site come from five sources with different as-on dates. No single "data as of" date applies, and no trend may be drawn across them.
coverage.heading: Coverage & limitations
unavailable.heading: Unavailable capabilities
unavailable.intro: Each capability below is reported with its reason and the condition that would unblock it. None is hidden, and none is shown as zero.
reason.NOT_IDENTIFIABLE: Not identifiable — structural: the evidence cannot determine this, and more of the same data would not change that.
reason.NOT_ACQUIRED: Not acquired — the source exists but no snapshot has been taken.
reason.ACCESS_PENDING: Access pending — identified, but access is unresolved.
reason.NOT_AVAILABLE: Not available — not published at the grain required.
reason.NOT_SUPPORTED_YET: Not supported yet — blocked by a temporal condition, not a structural one.
reason.PROHIBITED: Prohibited — doing this would invent data.
